title: Estimation of the Radiographic Parameters for Hallux Valgus From Photography of the Feet Using a Deep Convolutional Neural Network.
summary: The original full text uses paired foot photographs and weight-bearing radiographs from clinic patients; an ImageNet-pretrained Xception model was adapted to regress three hallux-valgus angles. Patient-level five-fold validation found substantial agreement for HVA (κ=.809), with weaker agreement for other angles.
ai_technology: paired photos and radiographic ground truth, patient-grouped folds; R²=.684/.573/.381 and HVA severity κ=.809. AI operation assessed from original Methods.
